entries.zh: 合唱团一致欢迎新的排练时间。

entries.en: The exhibition demonstrates the extraction of colour from plant material.
entries.zh: 展览演示了从植物材料中提取颜色的过程。

entries.en: The preface explains the genesis of her first novel.
entries.zh: 序言解释了她第一部小说的创作缘起。

entries.en: The telescope recorded changes in stellar brightness overnight.
entries.zh: 望远镜整夜记录了恒星亮度的变化。

entries.en: Her practice regimen included scales before every rehearsal.
entries.zh: 她固定的练习安排包括每次排练前练音阶。

entries.en: The cancellation of the ferry changed our entire itinerary.
entries.zh: 渡轮取消，改变了我们的整个行程。

entries.en: The biology illustration shows a fetus at an early stage.
entries.zh: 生物插图展示了早期阶段的胎儿。

entries.en: Please help yourselves to the biscuits beside the tea.
entries.zh: 请你们自行取用茶旁的饼干。

entries.en: Her portrayal of village life combines warmth with careful observation.
entries.zh: 她对乡村生活的描绘兼具温情与细致观察。

entries.en: I reduced the screen's brightness before opening the photographs.
entries.zh: 打开照片前，我调低了屏幕亮度。

entries.en: The memoir follows a school dropout who became a successful carpenter.
entries.zh: 回忆录讲述了一位辍学者成为成功木匠的经历。

entries.en: The presenter introduced each musician with a short story.
entries.zh: 主持人为每位音乐家都讲了一段简短介绍。

entries.en: I instinctively reached for the cup as it slipped.
entries.zh: 杯子滑落时，我本能地伸手去接。

entries.en: A coil of rope lay beside the rowing boat.
entries.zh: 一卷绳子放在划艇旁边。

entries.en: The new windows improved ventilation in the pottery studio.
entries.zh: 新窗户改善了陶艺工作室的通风。

entries.en: She yearned to see the sea after years inland.
entries.zh: 在内陆住了多年后，她渴望看海。

entries.en: A rectangular mirror hung above the narrow desk.
entries.zh: 窄书桌上方挂着一面长方形镜子。

entries.en: The proposed timetable was practicable with two rehearsal rooms.
entries.zh: 有两间排练室的话，拟定的时间表是可行的。

entries.en: The farmer plowed the lower field before sunset.
entries.zh: 农夫在日落前犁了低处的田。

entries.en: The renovation revealed old insulation beneath the attic floor.
entries.zh: 翻新时，阁楼地板下的旧隔热材料显露出来。

entries.en: Her familiarity with the archive saved us several hours.
entries.zh: 她熟悉档案馆，为我们省下了几个小时。

entries.en: The lecture compared physiological responses in different animal species.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了不同动物物种的生理反应。

entries.en: The sudden termination of the recording left the story unfinished.
entries.zh: 录音突然终止，故事没能讲完。

entries.en: The automated display opens its wooden doors every hour.
entries.zh: 自动化展项每小时打开一次木门。

entries.en: Our neighbours play softball in the park on Sundays.
entries.zh: 邻居们周日在公园打垒球。

entries.en: The café was moderately busy when we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们到达时，咖啡馆有些忙，但不算拥挤。

entries.en: After the long journey, exhaustion overcame her excitement.
entries.zh: 长途旅行后，疲惫盖过了她的兴奋。

entries.en: The new theatre supported the regeneration of the old waterfront.
entries.zh: 新剧院推动了旧滨水区的复兴。

entries.en: Image compression made the photograph small enough to email.
entries.zh: 图像压缩让照片小到可以通过邮件发送。

entries.en: The expert questioned the authenticity of the signed letter.
entries.zh: 专家质疑了那封签名信的真实性。

entries.en: The old building retained its original designation as a schoolhouse.
entries.zh: 旧建筑保留了原先“校舍”的名称。

entries.en: The invitation expressly asked guests to leave large bags outside.
entries.zh: 邀请函明确要求客人把大包留在外面。
